cbb9eb4dc3428a1a.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.observedConditionalRatioCDF
cbb9eb4dc3428a1a.statement:
/-- The continuous conditional-CDF version selected from the observed laws alone. If no
continuous version exists, this retains the raw `condDistrib`/zero fallback. -/
noncomputable def observedConditionalRatioCDF
    (laws : ObservedProbabilityLawFamily n) (order : Fin n → ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    ℝ → PredecessorLogRatios order i → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
  classical
  exact if h : ∃ C, IsContinuousConditionalRatioCDFVersion laws order i C then
    Classical.choose h
  else rawObservedConditionalRatioCDFUnit laws order i

8954081d50f95b5c.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.populationDecoder
8954081d50f95b5c.statement:
/-- The law-only population recovery map.  It forms the Gaussian-MMD graph, selects its own
topological ordering, constructs unit-interval ranks, and returns the parent-pruned DAG. -/
def populationDecoder (laws : ObservedProbabilityLawFamily n) :
    (Fin n → Fin n → Prop) ×
      (Fin n → LatentState n → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) × Causalean.DAG (Fin n) :=
  let order := selectedTopologicalOrder laws
  (observedLawRatioGraph gaussianFeatureMap laws.1,
    observedLawRankCoordinate laws order, selectedParentDAG laws order)

5f6d988646640e15.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.ComponentwiseC2Equivalent
5f6d988646640e15.statement:
/-- The componentwise `C²` ambiguity relating two compatible representations. -/
def ComponentwiseC2Equivalent
    {n : ℕ} {G₁ G₂ : Causalean.DAG (Fin n)}
    {θ₁ : Mechanism n G₁} {θ₂ : Mechanism n G₂}
    (W₁ : ObservedWorld G₁ θ₁) (W₂ : ObservedWorld G₂ θ₂) : Prop :=
  observedSupport G₁ W₁ = observedSupport G₂ W₂ ∧
  ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n),
    (∀ j i, G₂.edge (σ j) (σ i) ↔ G₁.edge j i) ∧
    (∀ e, W₂.targetPerm e = σ (W₁.targetPerm e)) ∧
    ∃ h hinv : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ,
      (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (h i) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) ∧
      (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (hinv i) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) ∧
      (∀ i, Set.MapsTo (h i) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) ∧
      (∀ i, Set.MapsTo (hinv i) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) ∧
      (∀ i z, z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → hinv i (h i z) = z) ∧
      (∀ i z, z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → h i (hinv i z) = z) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ observedSupport G₁ W₁, ∀ i,
        W₂.unmix x (σ i) = h i (W₁.unmix x i))

47dfff07279097cd.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.exact_ratio_decoder
47dfff07279097cd.statement:
/-- Cover-separated positive smooth causal-minimal mechanisms are decoded exactly from their
observed environment laws, up to relabeling and componentwise `C²` diffeomorphisms.  Given [the stated inputs and conditions](hyp:hpos,hminimal,hmix,hone,hsign,hcover,world), [the stated conclusion](goal) follows. -/
theorem exact_ratio_decoder
    {n : ℕ} {G : Causalean.DAG (Fin n)} (s : SignVector n)
    (θ : Mechanism n G) (world : ∀ θ' : Mechanism n G, ObservedWorld G θ')
    (hpos : PositiveNormalizedSmoothMechanisms G θ)
    (hminimal : CausalMinimality G θ)
    (hmix : SharedDiffeomorphicMixing G θ (world θ))
    (hone : OnePerfectInterventionPerNode G θ (world θ))
    (hsign : FixedOwnDerivativeSign G s θ)
    (hcover : (⟨θ, ⟨hpos, hminimal, hsign⟩⟩ : StratumPoint G s) ∈
      coverSeparatedSet (s := s) gaussianFeatureMap (world θ).targetPerm) :
    ExactRatioDecoderConclusion s θ (world θ)

1ef8a026d0f636b3.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.SampleSplitWorld
1ef8a026d0f636b3.statement:
/-- A sample-split experiment over a fixed observed environment family. -/
structure SampleSplitWorld {n : ℕ} {G : Causalean.DAG (Fin n)} {θ : Mechanism n G}
    (W : ObservedWorld G θ) (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] where
  probability : Measure Ω
  sampleSize : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ -- @realizes \(N_e\)(environment sample sizes)
  evaluation : ∀ e, Fin (sampleSize e) → Ω → LatentState n
  trainingSize : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ
  training : ∀ e, Fin (trainingSize e) → Ω → LatentState n
  ratioFit : (∀ e, Fin (trainingSize e) → LatentState n) →
    Fin n → LatentState n → ℝ
    -- @realizes \(\widehat R_i\)(measurable function fitted from the full training fold)
  ratioFit_joint_measurable : ∀ i,
    Measurable (Function.uncurry (fun T x => ratioFit T i x))
    -- @realizes \(\widehat R_i\)(joint measurability in training data and evaluation point)
  ratioFit_measurable : ∀ T i, Measurable (ratioFit T i)
    -- @realizes \(\widehat R_i\)(measurable as a function of the observation)
  ratioFit_pos : ∀ T i x, 0 < ratioFit T i x
    -- @realizes \(\widehat R_i\)(strictly positive range)
  firstStageRadius : ℝ → ℝ -- @realizes \(a_N\)(radius indexed by first-stage failure level)
  firstStageRadius_nonneg : ∀ η, 0 ≤ firstStageRadius η
    -- @realizes \(a_N\)(nonnegative range)
  alpha : ℝ -- @realizes \(\alpha\)(familywise evaluation error level)
  alpha_mem : alpha ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 -- @realizes \(\alpha\)(range (0,1))
  eta : ℝ -- @realizes \(\eta\)(first-stage failure level)
  eta_mem : eta ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 -- @realizes \(\eta\)(range (0,1))

dea6dcba42888bfb.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.IndependentEnvironmentSampling
dea6dcba42888bfb.statement:
/-- Evaluation observations are independent within each environment, have the stated environment
law, and the complete evaluation fold is independent of the training fold. -/
def IndependentEnvironmentSampling : Prop :=
  IsProbabilityMeasure S.probability ∧
  (∀ e, IsProbabilityMeasure (W.law e)) ∧
  (∀ e r, Measurable (S.training e r)) ∧
  (∀ e, ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (S.training e) S.probability) ∧
  (∀ e r, Measure.map (S.training e r) S.probability = W.law e) ∧
  (∀ e r, Measurable (S.evaluation e r)) ∧
  (∀ e, ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (S.evaluation e) S.probability) ∧
  (∀ e r, Measure.map (S.evaluation e r) S.probability = W.law e) ∧
  ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun (trainingFold S) (allEvaluationData S) S.probability ∧
  (∀ i x, @Measurable Ω ℝ (MeasurableSpace.comap (trainingFold S) inferInstance)
    inferInstance (fun ω => S.ratioEstimate ω i x)) ∧
  (∀ i, @Measurable (Ω × LatentState n) ℝ
    ((MeasurableSpace.comap (trainingFold S) inferInstance).prod inferInstance)
    inferInstance (fun p => S.ratioEstimate p.1 i p.2)) ∧
  @MeasurableSet Ω (MeasurableSpace.comap (trainingFold S) inferInstance)
    (firstStageL1Event S)

3280d2fb22e94c34.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.empiricalDiscrepancy
3280d2fb22e94c34.statement:
/-- The sample-split empirical Gaussian-kernel MMD. -/
def empiricalDiscrepancy
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (U : UnitNormFeatureMap H) (j i : Fin n) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  ‖empiricalMeanEmbedding S U j.succ i ω - empiricalMeanEmbedding S U 0 i ω‖

83c062fbe67ec347.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.sampleSplitConfidenceGraph
83c062fbe67ec347.statement:
/-- The graph selected by positive lower confidence bounds for population discrepancies. -/
def sampleSplitConfidenceGraph
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (U : UnitNormFeatureMap H) (_hSampling : IndependentEnvironmentSampling S)
    (ω : Ω) : Fin n → Fin n → Prop :=
  fun j i => j ≠ i ∧ 0 < empiricalDiscrepancy S U j i ω - confidenceRadius S

58cba073cc9bc037.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.simultaneous_confidence_edges
58cba073cc9bc037.statement:
/-- Under the simultaneous first-stage event, sample splitting yields familywise MMD confidence
bounds. Selected arrows are ancestral, and a two-radius cover margin recovers the true transitive
closure.  Given [the stated inputs and conditions](hyp:hpos,hmix,hone,hSampling,hn,hN,hα,hη,hfirst), [the stated conclusion](goal) follows. -/
theorem simultaneous_confidence_edges
    {n : ℕ} {G : Causalean.DAG (Fin n)} {s : SignVector n}
    {θ : Mechanism n G} (W : ObservedWorld G θ)
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (S : SampleSplitWorld W Ω)
    (hpos : PositiveNormalizedSmoothMechanisms G θ)
    (hmix : SharedDiffeomorphicMixing G θ W)
    (hone : OnePerfectInterventionPerNode G θ W)
    (hSampling : IndependentEnvironmentSampling S)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hN : ∀ e, 1 ≤ S.sampleSize e)
    (hα : S.alpha ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hη : S.eta ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hfirst : 1 - S.eta ≤ S.probability.real (firstStageL1Event S)) :
    ConditionalProbabilityAtLeast S.probability
      (MeasurableSpace.comap (trainingFold S) inferInstance)
      (simultaneousMmdEvent S gaussianFeatureMap) (firstStageL1Event S)
      (1 - S.alpha) ∧
    1 - S.alpha - S.eta ≤
      S.probability.real (simultaneousMmdEvent S gaussianFeatureMap) ∧
    (∀ ω ∈ simultaneousMmdEvent S gaussianFeatureMap, ∀ j i,
      sampleSplitConfidenceGraph S gaussianFeatureMap hSampling ω j i →
      G.isAncestor (W.targetPerm j) (W.targetPerm i)) ∧
    ((∀ j i, ancestralCover G (W.targetPerm j) (W.targetPerm i) →
        2 * confidenceRadius S < populationDiscrepancy gaussianFeatureMap W j i) →
      ∀ ω ∈ simultaneousMmdEvent S gaussianFeatureMap,
        Relation.TransGen (sampleSplitConfidenceGraph S gaussianFeatureMap hSampling ω) =
          Relation.TransGen (permutedGraph G W))

bafef0cdd85bc4c5.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.BoundedHolderRadius
bafef0cdd85bc4c5.statement:
/-- All observational mechanisms, intervention densities, and unmixed log ratios lie in the
common Hölder ball of order `β` and radius `M`. -/
def BoundedHolderRadius (_R : BoundedRegime W) (β M : ℝ) : Prop :=
  2 < β ∧ -- @realizes \(\beta\)(range (2,infinity))
  1 < M ∧ -- @realizes M(range (1,infinity))
  (∀ i, HolderOrderBound β M (θ.p i) (latentCube n)) ∧
  (∀ i, HolderOrderBound β M (θ.q i) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) ∧
  (∀ i, HolderOrderBound β M
    (fun v => logRatio G W i (W.mix v)) (latentCube n))

f754dad0bb0d8a7a.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.DensityLowerEnvelope
f754dad0bb0d8a7a.statement:
/-- Every observational and intervention density is uniformly bounded below by `c`. -/
def DensityLowerEnvelope (_R : BoundedRegime W) (c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  c ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ -- @realizes c(range (0,1))
  (∀ i v, v ∈ latentCube n → c ≤ θ.p i v) ∧
  (∀ i z, z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → c ≤ θ.q i z)

ce7a822746f8a26b.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.OwnDerivativeMargin
ce7a822746f8a26b.statement:
/-- Every signed own-coordinate observed log-ratio derivative is at least `c`. -/
def OwnDerivativeMargin (_R : BoundedRegime W) (c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ i v, v ∈ latentCube n →
    c ≤ s.value i *
      derivWithin (fun z => logRatio G W i (W.mix (Function.update v i z)))
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (v i)

4b58b59b7180d81f.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.CommonInteriorDomain
4b58b59b7180d81f.statement:
/-- The latent preimage of `K` is at least `ρ` from the boundary of the latent cube. -/
def CommonInteriorDomain (_R : BoundedRegime W) (K : Set (LatentState n)) (ρ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ρ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2) ∧ -- @realizes \(\rho\)(range (0,1/2))
  IsCompact K ∧ -- @realizes \(K\)(compactness)
  K ⊆ interior (observedSupport G W) ∧ -- @realizes \(K\)(common interior domain)
  ∀ v ∈ W.unmix '' K,
    ρ ≤ Metric.infDist v (frontier (latentCube n))

7df237771c02bce2.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.BoundedSharedMixingGeometry
7df237771c02bce2.statement:
/-- The shared map, inverse map, and both Jacobian determinants obey the uniform `C²` envelope. -/
def BoundedSharedMixingGeometry (_R : BoundedRegime W) (M : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ 2 W.mix (latentCube n) ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ 2 W.unmix (observedSupport G W) ∧
  (∀ v ∈ latentCube n,
    ‖W.mix v‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖fderivWithin ℝ W.mix (latentCube n) v‖ ≤ M ∧
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ 2 W.mix (latentCube n) v‖ ≤ M ∧
      |jacobianDeterminantWithin W.mix (latentCube n) v| ≤ M) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ observedSupport G W,
    ‖W.unmix x‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖fderivWithin ℝ W.unmix (observedSupport G W) x‖ ≤ M ∧
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ 2 W.unmix (observedSupport G W) x‖ ≤ M ∧
      |jacobianDeterminantWithin W.unmix (observedSupport G W) x| ≤ M)

9114856236a8d825.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.ObservedLogRatioRegularity
9114856236a8d825.statement:
/-- Every observed log ratio has uniformly bounded value and first two derivatives on `K`. -/
def ObservedLogRatioRegularity
    (_R : BoundedRegime W) (K : Set (LatentState n)) (M : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (logRatio G W i) K) ∧
  ∀ i x, x ∈ K →
      |logRatio G W i x| ≤ M ∧
      ‖fderivWithin ℝ (logRatio G W i) K x‖ ≤ M ∧
      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ 2 (logRatio G W i) K x‖ ≤ M

7ecdd1ffeec6241d.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.ConditionalDesignEnvelope
7ecdd1ffeec6241d.statement:
/-- For each environment, some density version of the law of its conditioning coordinates obeys
the empty-predecessor convention and lies between `c` and `M` on its induced domain. -/
def ConditionalDesignEnvelope
    (R : BoundedRegime W) (c M : ℝ) (K : Set (LatentState n)) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, ∃ hmeas : AEMeasurable
      (familyProjection (logRatio G W) (predecessorSet R.order i)) (W.law i.succ),
    ∃ g : (((j : {j // j ∈ predecessorSet R.order i}) → ℝ) → ℝ),
      (predecessorSet R.order i = ∅ → g = fun _ => 1) ∧
        -- @realizes \(g_i\)(identically one when B_i is empty)
      Measure.map
          (hmeas.mk (familyProjection (logRatio G W) (predecessorSet R.order i)))
          (W.law i.succ) =
        volume.withDensity (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (g z)) ∧
        -- @realizes \(g_i\)(law-derived density version of L_Bi(X) under P^i)
      ∀ z, z ∈ conditioningDomain R K i →
        c ≤ g z ∧ g z ≤ M

e98a4852c739d32e.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.BoundedHolderSubclass
e98a4852c739d32e.statement:
/-- Membership evidence for the bounded Hölder subclass, indexed by a point of the full model
stratum. Its extension is `boundedSubclassSet`. -/
structure BoundedHolderSubclass
    (world : ∀ θs : StratumPoint G s, ModelGeneratedObservedWorld G θs.1)
    (regime : ∀ θs : StratumPoint G s, DecoderSelectedBoundedRegime (world θs))
    (β c M : ℝ) (K : Set (LatentState n)) (ρ : ℝ)
    (θs : StratumPoint G s) : Prop where
  holderRadius : BoundedHolderRadius (regime θs).1 β M
  densityLower : DensityLowerEnvelope (regime θs).1 c
  derivativeMargin : OwnDerivativeMargin (s := s) (regime θs).1 c
  interiorDomain : CommonInteriorDomain (regime θs).1 K ρ
  mixingGeometry : BoundedSharedMixingGeometry (regime θs).1 M
  ratioRegularity : ObservedLogRatioRegularity (regime θs).1 K M
  designEnvelope : ConditionalDesignEnvelope (regime θs).1 c M K

0472e9a2601e1192.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.BoundedRegime
0472e9a2601e1192.statement:
/-- Parameters of the bounded generated-rank regime. -/
structure BoundedRegime {n : ℕ} {G : Causalean.DAG (Fin n)} {θ : Mechanism n G}
    (W : ObservedWorld G θ) where
  order : Fin n → ℕ
  sampleSizeSequence : ℕ → Fin (n + 1) → ℕ -- @realizes \(N_e\)(sample-size sequence)
  ratioRate : ℕ → ℝ -- @realizes \(b_N\)(uniform first-stage C1 rate)
  ratioRate_pos : ∀ N, 0 < ratioRate N -- @realizes \(b_N\)(positive sequence)
  ratioRate_zero : Tendsto ratioRate atTop (𝓝 0) -- @realizes \(b_N\)(converges to zero)
  failureRate : ℕ → ℝ -- @realizes \(\eta_N\)(first-stage failure sequence)
  failureRate_pos : ∀ N, 0 < failureRate N -- @realizes \(\eta_N\)(positive sequence)
  failureRate_zero : Tendsto failureRate atTop (𝓝 0) -- @realizes \(\eta_N\)(converges to zero)
  bandwidth : ℕ → ℝ -- @realizes \(h_N\)(second-stage bandwidth)
  bandwidth_pos : ∀ N, 0 < bandwidth N -- @realizes \(h_N\)(positive sequence)

1f808e63081fa155.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.firstStageRatioContract
1f808e63081fa155.statement:
/-- The common `N`-indexed first-stage contract over the bounded subclass. Each sampling world
uses the regime's environment sample-size sequence, and the event is explicitly measurable. -/
def firstStageRatioContract {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (world : ∀ θs : StratumPoint G s, ModelGeneratedObservedWorld G θs.1)
    (regime : ∀ θs : StratumPoint G s, DecoderSelectedBoundedRegime (world θs))
    (sampling : ∀ (θs : StratumPoint G s) (_N : ℕ),
      SampleSplitWorld (world θs).1 Ω)
    (sampleSizeSequence : ℕ → Fin (n + 1) → ℕ)
    (bN etaN : ℕ → ℝ)
    (β c M : ℝ) (K : Set (LatentState n)) (ρ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ N, 0 < bN N) ∧ Tendsto bN atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
  (∀ N, 0 < etaN N) ∧ Tendsto etaN atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
  ∀ N θs, θs ∈ boundedSubclassSet world regime β c M K ρ →
    (regime θs).1.sampleSizeSequence = sampleSizeSequence ∧
    (regime θs).1.ratioRate = bN ∧
    (regime θs).1.failureRate = etaN ∧
    IndependentEnvironmentSampling (sampling θs N) ∧
    (sampling θs N).sampleSize = sampleSizeSequence N ∧
    MeasurableSet (uniformC1RatioEvent (sampling θs N) (bN N)) ∧
    1 - etaN N ≤
      (sampling θs N).probability.real
        (uniformC1RatioEvent (sampling θs N) (bN N))

9cf8c822335ee639.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.uniformC1RatioEvent
9cf8c822335ee639.statement:
-- @realizes \(\Theta^{\beta}_{G,s}(c,M,K,\rho)\)(seven-property bounded subset)

/-- The uniform `C¹` log-ratio error event, including `C¹` membership of the fitted and true
log-ratios rather than only pointwise derivative inequalities. -/
def uniformC1RatioEvent {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (S : SampleSplitWorld W Ω) (b : ℝ) : Set Ω :=
  {ω | ∀ i,
    ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => Real.log (S.ratioEstimate ω i y)) (observedSupport G W) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (logRatio G W i) (observedSupport G W) ∧
    ∀ x ∈ observedSupport G W,
      |Real.log (S.ratioEstimate ω i x) - logRatio G W i x| ≤ b ∧
      ‖fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => Real.log (S.ratioEstimate ω i y))
          (observedSupport G W) x -
        fderivWithin ℝ (logRatio G W i) (observedSupport G W) x‖ ≤ b}

2a1c92f5f1db1c44.label: SampleSplitWorld
2a1c92f5f1db1c44.statement:
/-- A sample-split experiment over a fixed observed environment family. -/
structure SampleSplitWorld {n : ℕ} {G : Causalean.DAG (Fin n)} {θ : Mechanism n G}
    (W : ObservedWorld G θ) (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] where
  probability : Measure Ω
  sampleSize : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ -- @realizes \(N_e\)(environment sample sizes)
  evaluation : ∀ e, Fin (sampleSize e) → Ω → LatentState n
  trainingSize : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ
  training : ∀ e, Fin (trainingSize e) → Ω → LatentState n
  ratioFit : (∀ e, Fin (trainingSize e) → LatentState n) →
    Fin n → LatentState n → ℝ
    -- @realizes \(\widehat R_i\)(measurable function fitted from the full training fold)
  ratioFit_joint_measurable : ∀ i,
    Measurable (Function.uncurry (fun T x => ratioFit T i x))
    -- @realizes \(\widehat R_i\)(joint measurability in training data and evaluation point)
  ratioFit_measurable : ∀ T i, Measurable (ratioFit T i)
    -- @realizes \(\widehat R_i\)(measurable as a function of the observation)
  ratioFit_pos : ∀ T i x, 0 < ratioFit T i x
    -- @realizes \(\widehat R_i\)(strictly positive range)
  firstStageRadius : ℝ → ℝ -- @realizes \(a_N\)(radius indexed by first-stage failure level)
  firstStageRadius_nonneg : ∀ η, 0 ≤ firstStageRadius η
    -- @realizes \(a_N\)(nonnegative range)
  alpha : ℝ -- @realizes \(\alpha\)(familywise evaluation error level)
  alpha_mem : alpha ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 -- @realizes \(\alpha\)(range (0,1))
  eta : ℝ -- @realizes \(\eta\)(first-stage failure level)
  eta_mem : eta ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 -- @realizes \(\eta\)(range (0,1))

/-- Nodewise normalized affine interpolation, indexed exactly by `t ∈ [0,1]`. -/
def affinePath {n : ℕ} {G : Causalean.DAG (Fin n)} (s : SignVector n)
    (θ : StratumPoint G s) {j i : Fin n} (hji : G.edge j i)
    (t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : Mechanism n G :=
  affinePathExtension s θ hji t.1

9802505b75103cbf.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.affinePathExtension
9802505b75103cbf.statement:
/-- For a [finite dimension](hyp:n), [DAG](hyp:G), [sign pattern](hyp:s), [stratum point](hyp:θ),
[directed edge endpoints](hyp:j,i), [edge certificate](hyp:hji), and [real path parameter](hyp:t),
the [unrestricted affine mechanism path](goal) interpolates toward the embedded sparse witness. -/
def affinePathExtension {n : ℕ} {G : Causalean.DAG (Fin n)} (s : SignVector n)
    (θ : StratumPoint G s) {j i : Fin n} (hji : G.edge j i) (t : ℝ) : Mechanism n G where
  p := fun l v => (1 - t) * θ.1.p l v + t * (embeddedSparseWitness s hji).p l v
  q := fun l z => (1 - t) * θ.1.q l z + t * (embeddedSparseWitness s hji).q l z
  parent_local := affinePath_parent_local θ.1 (embeddedSparseWitness s hji) t

d2ce9b3080d5a489.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.embeddedSparseWitness
d2ce9b3080d5a489.statement:
/-- The edge-specific sparse endpoint used by the affine perturbation. -/
def embeddedSparseWitness {n : ℕ} {G : Causalean.DAG (Fin n)}
    (s : SignVector n) {j i : Fin n} (hji : G.edge j i) : Mechanism n G where
  p := embeddedSparseP s j i
  q := fun l z => exponentialInterventionDensity (reflectedCoordinate s l z)
  parent_local := embeddedSparseP_parent_local s hji

/-- The environment-`j` minus observational second-moment contrast of ratio `i`. -/
def secondMomentContrast {θ : Mechanism n G} (W : ObservedWorld G θ)
    (j i : Fin n) : ℝ :=
  (∫ x, (W.ratio i x) ^ 2 ∂W.law j.succ) -
    ∫ x, (W.ratio i x) ^ 2 ∂W.law 0

ee169c4c534cabb7.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.analytic_edge_perturbation
ee169c4c534cabb7.statement:
/-- Every edge admits arbitrarily small stratum-preserving affine perturbations with nonzero
second-moment contrast; the contrast has the stated analytic integral and isolated zeros.  Given [the stated inputs and conditions](hyp:hji,hIntervention), [the stated conclusion](goal) follows. -/
lemma analytic_edge_perturbation
    {n : ℕ} {G : Causalean.DAG (Fin n)} {s : SignVector n}
    (θs : StratumPoint G s) {j i : Fin n} (hji : G.edge j i)
    (hIntervention : OnePerfectInterventionPerNode G θs.1
      (canonicalObservedWorld G θs.1 (Equiv.refl (Fin n)))) :
    (∃ O : Set ℝ, IsOpen O ∧ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ O ∧
      (∀ t ∈ O, affinePathContrast s θs hji t =
        affinePathContrastIntegral s θs hji t) ∧
      AnalyticOnNhd ℝ (affinePathContrast s θs hji) O ∧
      ∀ t ∈ O, affinePathContrast s θs hji t = 0 →
        ∃ ε > 0, ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (t - ε) (t + ε), u ≠ t →
          affinePathContrast s θs hji u ≠ 0) ∧
    affinePathContrast s θs hji 1 ≠ 0 ∧
    (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 θs.1, ∃ t : {t : ℝ // t ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1},
      affinePath s θs hji ⟨t.1, ⟨le_of_lt t.2.1, le_of_lt t.2.2⟩⟩ ∈ N ∧
      ModelStratum G s (affinePath s θs hji
        ⟨t.1, ⟨le_of_lt t.2.1, le_of_lt t.2.2⟩⟩) ∧
      affinePathContrast s θs hji t.1 ≠ 0)

d4fc67441edd273b.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.equationTen_interventionMarginalDensity
d4fc67441edd273b.statement:
/-- Equation (10) at the density-elimination level: under the current intervention, retaining
the target and all predecessor coordinates leaves the replacement density times the remaining
retained observational factors.  Given [the stated inputs and conditions](hyp:hpos,horder,hgraphOrder), [the stated conclusion](goal) follows. -/
lemma equationTen_interventionMarginalDensity
    {n : ℕ} {G : Causalean.DAG (Fin n)} {θ : Mechanism n G}
    (W : ObservedWorld G θ) (hpos : PositiveNormalizedSmoothMechanisms G θ)
    {order : Fin n → ℕ}
    (horder : IsTopologicalOrdering (observedLawRatioGraph gaussianFeatureMap W.law) order)
    (hgraphOrder : PermutedGraphOrdered W order) (i : Fin n) :
    let B := mechanismUnitCubeFactorization hpos
    let q := mechanismInterventionDensity W hpos i
    let A := decoderRetainedLatentSet W order i
    (∫⋯∫⁻_(Finset.univ \ A), B.interventionDensity (W.targetPerm i) q
        ∂fun _ : Fin n => Causalean.Graph.FiniteDensity.unitIntervalReference) =
      fun v => q.density (v (W.targetPerm i)) * B.partialDensity (A.erase (W.targetPerm i)) v

d5a4a5850a5c33a4.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.equationTen_interventionMarginalDensity_fiber_product
d5a4a5850a5c33a4.statement:
/-- Equation (10) in explicit fiber-product form: after fixing predecessor coordinates,
the retained intervention density is the own-coordinate replacement density times a factor
that is constant along that coordinate's fiber.  Given [the stated inputs and conditions](hyp:hpos,horder,hgraphOrder), [the stated conclusion](goal) follows. -/
lemma equationTen_interventionMarginalDensity_fiber_product
    {n : ℕ} {G : Causalean.DAG (Fin n)} {θ : Mechanism n G}
    (W : ObservedWorld G θ) (hpos : PositiveNormalizedSmoothMechanisms G θ)
    {order : Fin n → ℕ}
    (horder : IsTopologicalOrdering (observedLawRatioGraph gaussianFeatureMap W.law) order)
    (hgraphOrder : PermutedGraphOrdered W order) (i : Fin n)
    (v : LatentState n) (w : ℝ) :
    let B := mechanismUnitCubeFactorization hpos
    let q := mechanismInterventionDensity W hpos i
    let A := decoderRetainedLatentSet W order i
    (∫⋯∫⁻_(Finset.univ \ A),
        B.interventionDensity (W.targetPerm i) q
        ∂fun _ : Fin n => Causalean.Graph.FiniteDensity.unitIntervalReference)
        (Function.update v (W.targetPerm i) w) =
      q.density w * B.partialDensity (A.erase (W.targetPerm i)) v

d6c490d700704596.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.observedRatioPredecessor_compProd
d6c490d700704596.statement:
/-- Under intervention `i`, the observed predecessor-score and target-score law is the
predecessor marginal composed with the ambient equation-(11) Markov kernel.  Given [the stated inputs and conditions](hyp:hpos,hmix,hone,hsign,horder,hgraphOrder), [the stated conclusion](goal) follows. -/
lemma observedRatioPredecessor_compProd
    {n : ℕ} {G : Causalean.DAG (Fin n)} (s : SignVector n)
    {θ : Mechanism n G} (W : ObservedWorld G θ)
    (hpos : PositiveNormalizedSmoothMechanisms G θ)
    (hmix : SharedDiffeomorphicMixing G θ W)
    (hone : OnePerfectInterventionPerNode G θ W)
    (hsign : FixedOwnDerivativeSign G s θ)
    {order : Fin n → ℕ}
    (horder : IsTopologicalOrdering (observedLawRatioGraph gaussianFeatureMap W.law) order)
    (hgraphOrder : PermutedGraphOrdered W order) (i : Fin n) :
    Measure.map
        (fun x ↦
          (familyProjection (observedLawLogRatio W.law) (predecessorSet order i) x,
            observedLawLogRatio W.law i x)) (W.law i.succ) =
      Measure.map
          (familyProjection (observedLawLogRatio W.law) (predecessorSet order i))
          (W.law i.succ) ⊗ₘ
        equationElevenAmbientKernel s W hpos hmix hone hsign horder hgraphOrder i

a3716c0168603125.label: CausalSmith.ExactID.EID_CrlCoverratioMmdGenericity.bounded_rkhs_empirical_mean
a3716c0168603125.statement:
/-- Conditional on training, all environment/ratio empirical feature means obey the stated
unit-norm Hilbert-space deviation bound with probability at least `1-α`.  Given [the stated inputs and conditions](hyp:hSampling,hn,hN,hα), [the stated conclusion](goal) follows. -/
lemma bounded_rkhs_empirical_mean
    {n : ℕ} {G : Causalean.DAG (Fin n)} {θ : Mechanism n G}
    {W : ObservedWorld G θ} {Ω H : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H]
    (S : SampleSplitWorld W Ω) (U : UnitNormFeatureMap H)
    (hSampling : ConditionalEvaluationSampling S)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hN : ∀ e, 1 ≤ S.sampleSize e)
    (hα : S.alpha ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ConditionalProbabilityAtLeast S.probability
      (MeasurableSpace.comap (trainingFold S) inferInstance)
      {ω | ∀ i : Fin n, ∀ e : Fin (n + 1),
        ‖empiricalMeanEmbedding S U e i ω - fittedMeanEmbedding S U e i ω‖ ≤
          (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.log
            ((n : ℝ) * (n + 1 : ℝ) / S.alpha))) /
            Real.sqrt (minimumSampleSize S)} Set.univ (1 - S.alpha)
